name: streamer
note: Starting weights, same set as `general` (no streamer-specific view data yet). Split into its own file so it re-weights from streamer campaigns' own posts only, instead of being pooled with every other niche. Re-weighted from our own clips' view counts once there are enough (PRD section 6).

categories.description: A clear setup followed by a payoff inside the clip.
Something unexpected happens that the viewer could not predict.
Disagreement, rivalry or tension between people.
A loud or visible reaction: shouting, laughter, shock.
One line people would repeat or comment.
What is at risk is stated in the first three seconds.

penalties.description: Makes no sense without the rest of the stream.
Nothing happens in the first three seconds.
The moment is mostly about another streamer, which most briefs ban.
